schema_note: Phase 1D-A observable-definition audit inventory, v1. Every object under a *_conclusion key (and every entry of conclusions arrays) carries exactly: classification, source, assumptions, derivation_summary, convention_dependencies, implementation_consequence. Classifications are exactly one of: VERIFIED_FROM_PRIMARY_SOURCE, DERIVED_FROM_VERIFIED_DEFINITIONS, NUMERICALLY_CORROBORATED, CONVENTION_DEPENDENT, PROVISIONAL, UNRESOLVED_EXTERNAL_DEPENDENCY, NOT_JUSTIFIED_FOR_OBSERVABLE_USE, FORBIDDEN_AS_A_SILENT_DEFAULT. Evidence levels are never merged; where several apply, the primary one is given and the others are listed in convention_dependencies or assumptions. Companion prose: reports/phase1d_a_growth_observable_audit.md.

variable_definitions.D_mu_i: comoving fractional density gradient, D_mu^(i) := (a/rho^(i)) D_mu rho^(i)  [GM (2.2)]; local scale factor a defined by adot/a := Theta/3 along the observer congruence, with ARBITRARY initialisation on a slice (GM p.5, verbatim)
variable_definitions.Delta_d: Delta^(d) := a D^mu D_mu^(d)  [GM (2.20)]; Delta ~= (a^2/rho) (3)Lap rho  [GM (2.19)]; 'proportional to 3-Laplacians of local source fields ... normalised to the local comoving length scale via a^2' (GM p.10 verbatim)
variable_definitions.Z: Z := a D^mu Z_mu with Z_mu := a D_mu Theta [GM (2.4),(2.21)]; in the documented solver harmonic convention Z_k = -k_code^2 (deltaTheta)_k; in volume-average coordinates the same factor is (k_com_D c/H0_TS)^2 or (k_phys0_D a_D0 c/H0_TS)^2 under the matching parametrisation; exactly Z = -dDelta_d/dt [GM (4.14)]
variable_definitions.Delta_eff: same construction for the effective fluid; scales quadratically with the harmonic label k_code in frequency space (GM p.21 statement)
variable_definitions.V_eff_tilt: V^(i) := a D^mu V_mu^(i) [GM (2.20)]: a-scaled divergence of the tilt velocity of the effective fluid RELATIVE TO THE DUST FRAME; Vtilde = (1+w_eff)V; scales linearly with k (GM p.21); no galaxy-peculiar-velocity meaning
variable_definitions.delta_m: conventional linear matter density contrast deltarho_d/rhobar_d in the dust frame (defined here, used for the mapping)

Delta_d_conclusion.source: [GM] Eqs. (2.2), (2.19), (2.20); p.10 and p.27 verbatim statements
Delta_d_conclusion.derivation_summary: Delta_d is the a^2-normalised spatial 3-Laplacian of the fractional dust density: NOT a local density contrast; at linear order Delta_d ~= a_D^2 (3)Lap delta_m; in code harmonics it is dimensionless because k_code is dimensionless; dimensional volume-average forms require k_com_D with c/H0_TS or k_phys0_D with a_D0 c/H0_TS; same definition for all three closures; dust-frame quantity; first-order gauge-invariant (vanishes in background)
Delta_d_conclusion.convention_dependencies: harmonic sign; k_code versus volume-average k_com_D or k_phys0_D; unresolved mapping to observational/dressed k_com_obs; unresolved upstream_timescape_k versus paper_lcdm_hubble_k interpretation; arbitrary scale-factor normalisation
Delta_d_conclusion.implementation_consequence: the notebook variable Delta_dust must never be fed to a spectrum/sigma_8 formula as if it were delta_m

frame_and_gauge.observer_frame: dust energy frame, V^(d)=0 [GM Sec. 4, pp. 15-16 verbatim: interpret CGI density perturbations as gradients in the observed density field; same foliation as the Buchert averaging (footnote 7)]
frame_and_gauge.gauge_invariance: all CGI variables vanish identically at FLRW background level, hence first-order gauge-invariant (Stewart-Walker); no gauge fixing anywhere

bardeen_correspondence_conclusion.source: [GM] (2.19)-(2.20) + footnote 8; attribution to [GM 48]/[GM 50] not verifiable locally
bardeen_correspondence_conclusion.derivation_summary: per harmonic mode Delta_d,k = -k_code^2 delta_m,k in the documented solver convention, equivalently -(k_com_D c/H0_TS)^2 delta_m,k or -(k_phys0_D a_D0 c/H0_TS)^2 delta_m,k in the volume-average-coordinate parametrisations; the identification of delta_m with the Bardeen comoving-gauge density contrast is standard but its original-reference attribution ([GM 48]) was not independently inspected
bardeen_correspondence_conclusion.convention_dependencies: harmonic sign; k_code/k_com_D/k_phys0_D units; volume-average versus unresolved observational/dressed comoving frame; F7 wavenumber convention
bardeen_correspondence_conclusion.implementation_consequence: growth rates and ratios transfer exactly without resolving the dimensional spatial mapping because the constant harmonic factor cancels; absolute amplitudes require one dimensionally complete matching factor and a documented sign

harmonic_conventions.eigenvalue: (3)Lap Q_k = -(k_code^2/a_D^2) Q_k, with k_code := ResolvedWavenumber.matrix_k; [GM] footnote 8 gives the k^2/a^2 magnitude; negative sign as implemented in (4.10) and audited in Phase 1C-A
harmonic_conventions.flat_background: KD = 0 chosen in [GM] Sec. 5: eigenfunctions are ordinary Fourier modes; k_code is a constant dimensionless harmonic label

k_units.dimensionless_solver_label: k_code is the dimensionless matrix label; exact solver mapping uses Delta_d,k = -k_code^2 delta_m,k
k_units.volume_average_comoving_wavenumber: k_com_D := k_code H0_TS/c is the dimensional comoving wavenumber associated with the volume-average spatial coordinates; k_code = k_com_D(c/H0_TS)
k_units.volume_average_physical_wavenumber: k_phys_D(t) := k_com_D/a_D(t) is the physical volume-average wavenumber at time t
k_units.present_volume_average_physical_wavenumb: k_phys0_D := k_phys_D(t0) = k_code H0_TS/(a_D0 c); k_code = k_phys0_D(a_D0 c/H0_TS)
k_units.observational_dressed_comoving_wavenumbe: k_com_obs (or k_com_dressed) is the future observational/dressed comoving wavenumber; its mapping from the volume-average harmonic coordinate is unresolved
k_units.reciprocal_unit_rule: each wavenumber must be paired only with its specifically associated reciprocal length: Mpc^-1 with Mpc, or numerical h Mpc^-1 with h^-1 Mpc
k_units.paper_lcdm_hubble_k: supplied k_paper = k_phys0_D c/H0_LCDM; solver resolves k_code=k_paper*a_D0*H0_LCDM/H0_TS, preserving k_phys0_D between the two numerical conventions but not deriving k_com_obs
k_units.unresolved_F7: whether the published numerical values {2pi,5pi,10pi} are upstream matrix labels or paper Hubble-length labels; conversion factor a_D0*h_lcdm/h_ts=1.259551; neither fork is ranked

harmonic_conventions.scaling_corroboration: [GM] p.21 verbatim: 'Vtilde^(eff) scales linearly with k, while Delta^(eff) exhibits a quadratic scaling'

delta_mapping.result_code: Delta_d(k_code,t) = -k_code^2 delta_m(k_code,t), exact for the documented negative-Laplacian harmonic convention
delta_mapping.equation_chain: Delta_d = a D^mu[(a/rho_d) D_mu rho_d] = (a^2/rhobar_d)(3)Lap(rhobar_d delta_m) + O(2) = a_D^2 (3)Lap delta_m -> a_D^2 * (-k_code^2/a_D^2) * delta_m,k = -k_code^2 delta_m,k = -(k_com_D c/H0_TS)^2 delta_m,k = -(k_phys0_D a_D0 c/H0_TS)^2 delta_m,k; a_D powers cancel exactly; no background-density factor; no frame/gauge transformation
delta_mapping.sympy_checks: S1 (formal epsilon-expansion), S2a (log-growth equality), S2b (time-dependent-C correction = dlnC/dlna): all PASS (scratchpad phase1d_symbolic.py)
delta_mapping.closure_validity: definitional, holds identically for meszaros/comoving/barotropic and for both D3 branches and both tilt forms
delta_mapping.wavenumber_convention_validity: algebra is identical after resolution; upstream_timescape_k supplies k_code directly, while paper_lcdm_hubble_k supplies k_paper=k_phys0_D c/H0_LCDM and the solver converts it to k_code by factor a_D0*h_lcdm/h_ts=1.259551; this preserves the intended present physical volume-average mode but does not derive k_com_obs

mapping_conclusion.assumptions: linear order; same scalar harmonic mode; constant dimensionless k_code; nonzero reference amplitude for a ratio; explicit sign/crossing policy
mapping_conclusion.derivation_summary: C=-k_code^2=-(k_com_D c/H0_TS)^2=-(k_phys0_D a_D0 c/H0_TS)^2 is time-independent and scale-dependent; therefore d ln|Delta_d,k|/dx = d ln|delta_m,k|/dx wherever amplitudes are nonzero
mapping_conclusion.convention_dependencies: amplitude sign changes if the harmonic/eigenvalue sign convention changes; |C|, growth ratios/rates, and spectra are sign-invariant; dimensional volume-average scales depend on the named parametrisation and F7; observational k_com_obs remains unresolved
mapping_conclusion.implementation_consequence: growth ratios/rates transfer per mode without resolving the dimensional spatial map because C cancels; absolute amplitude, spectra, sigma_R/sigma_8, and observational k-bin comparisons require explicit matching wavenumber/frame metadata

power_spectrum_mapping.fourier_convention: in one declared comoving frame X, delta(x_X) = int d^3k_com_X/(2pi)^3 delta_k_com_X e^{ik_com_X x_X}; <delta_k_com_X delta_k'_com_X*> = (2pi)^3 deltaD(k_com_X-k'_com_X) P_delta(k_com_X)
power_spectrum_mapping.result_code: P_Delta(k_code,t) = k_code^4 P_delta(k_code,t); Delta^2_Delta = k_code^4 Delta^2_delta for a common dimensionless harmonic label
power_spectrum_mapping.result_volume_average_comoving: P_Delta(k_com_D,t) = (k_com_D c/H0_TS)^4 P_delta(k_com_D,t), and likewise for dimensionless power, when both spectra use one common volume-average comoving Fourier/statistical normalisation
power_spectrum_mapping.result_present_volume_average_physical: P_Delta(k_phys0_D,t) = (k_phys0_D a_D0 c/H0_TS)^4 P_delta(k_phys0_D,t), and likewise for dimensionless power, only when both spectra use the same present physical volume-average parametrisation; this a_D0 form is not the comoving-Mpc^-1 formula
power_spectrum_mapping.equal_deterministic_ic_meaning: the notebook's equal deterministic Delta_d amplitudes define selected trajectory comparisons only, not an ensemble or P_Delta; conditionally, if interpreted as equal RMS amplitudes under one common statistical mode normalisation, the mapping would imply P_delta proportional to k_code^-4; that condition is not supplied by the notebook

spectrum_conclusion.assumptions: statistical homogeneity/isotropy; fixed Fourier convention; one common k parametrisation and spatial coordinate frame; the conditional equal-RMS inference requires an additional statistical mode normalisation absent upstream
spectrum_conclusion.derivation_summary: P_Delta=|C|^2 P_delta gives k_code^4, (k_com_D c/H0_TS)^4, or (k_phys0_D a_D0 c/H0_TS)^4 in the corresponding parametrisation; sign changes cancel
spectrum_conclusion.convention_dependencies: Fourier normalisation; k_code versus k_com_D versus k_phys0_D units; F7; unresolved k_com_obs mapping; harmonic sign does not affect power
spectrum_conclusion.implementation_consequence: sigma_R must convert Delta_d with the complete fourth-power factor in a matched comoving frame; equal deterministic upstream ICs cannot seed or normalise a spectrum

growth_definitions.growth_factor: G(k_code,t;t_ref) = Delta_d(k_code,t)/Delta_d(k_code,t_ref) = delta_m(k_code,t)/delta_m(k_code,t_ref) for the same harmonic mode (C cancels); defined iff reference amplitude is nonzero and subject to the explicit sign/crossing policy; no dimensional spatial mapping is required for this relative ratio; reference epoch must state value AND coordinate (bare time vs dressed redshift) - no default
growth_definitions.scale_independent_D_conditions: (i) k-free evolution operator: TRUE for comoving ([GM] p.19 verbatim) and Meszaros (4.27); FALSE for barotropic (k^2/a coupling, both D3 branches, [GM] p.22); (ii) k-independent initial mode-mixture Z(t_i)/Delta_d(t_i) (and Delta_eff IC): satisfied by upstream identical ICs; for physical spectra requires growing-mode dominance at t_i - must be stated explicitly
growth_definitions.f_bare: f_bare := d ln D/d ln a_D = -3 Z_k/(Theta Delta_d,k) exactly (sympy S4 PASS); no numerical differentiation needed
growth_definitions.wall_scale_normalisation: original notation: 1+z_dressed=a_w0/a_w and a_obs:=1/(1+z_dressed)=a_w/a_w0; define a_w_rescaled:=a_w/a_w0 and a_D_rescaled:=a_D/a_w0 before writing a_obs=a_w_rescaled=a_D_rescaled/gamma_w; frozen Phase 1B functions named a_w and a_D return these rescaled quantities
growth_definitions.f_dressed: f_dressed := d ln D/d ln a_obs = -(1+z_dressed) d ln D/dz_dressed with a_obs=a_w/a_w0=a_w_rescaled; the constant a_w0 cancels from logarithmic derivatives
growth_definitions.chain_rule: f_dressed = f_bare * H_D/(H_D - gammadot_w/gamma_w) = f_bare * gamma_w H_D/H_dressed = f_bare * (2+f_v)^2/(4+f_v+4f_v^2) (tracker exact; sympy S3b-S3f PASS; numeric N2 to <1e-8)
growth_definitions.lapse_role: gamma_w enters through the abscissa a_w_rescaled=a_D_rescaled/gamma_w; f is invariant under the clock choice and under constant a_w0 rescaling because it is a ratio of logarithmic derivatives
growth_definitions.paper_and_upstream_usage: [GM] defines no growth rate f; Figs. 2-3 plot against bare a_D/a_w0, so the upstream presentation coordinate is implicitly bare_aD; surveys quote dressed z

growth_coordinate_conclusion.source: [GM] p.25 redshift relation (VERIFIED_FROM_PRIMARY_SOURCE, validated Phase 1B); [GM] figure axes; derivation chain D3 in the report
growth_coordinate_conclusion.assumptions: tracker background; z is the dressed observational redshift
growth_coordinate_conclusion.derivation_summary: both f_bare and f_dressed are mathematically available and exactly interconvertible; a_obs=a_w/a_w0, and constant a_w0 cancels; neither coordinate is specified for a growth rate by the paper; the audited tracker conversion factor differs from unity by 2.5-8.4% at the tabulated epochs
growth_coordinate_conclusion.convention_dependencies: future mandatory labels bare_aD / dressed_redshift; NO DEFAULT (FORBIDDEN_AS_A_SILENT_DEFAULT applies to any silent choice)
growth_coordinate_conclusion.implementation_consequence: growth_coordinate must be a mandatory explicit argument of any f or fsigma8-like quantity

zero_crossing_policy.analytic_f: f_bare(k,t) = -3Z_k/(Theta Delta_d,k); poles where Delta_d,k=0 with Z_k!=0; zeros where Z_k=0; dD/dlna_D = -3Z_k/Theta finite everywhere

crossing_provenance.validator_definition: first_strict_zero_crossing_time is t[i], the left sample for which y[i]*y[i+1] < 0; it is not a root
crossing_provenance.solver_evidence: all seven B2 solver configurations place each first sign change in the same sampled bin; this is not an exact-root precision claim
crossing_provenance.root_refinement: not performed; precise roots remain a Phase 1D-B implementation task

zero_crossing_policy.clean_systems: Meszaros and comoving with upstream-convention ICs: zero sign changes in any component over [t_i, t0] (in-memory check on the frozen package, tight DOP853); f globally defined there
policy_items: never evaluate log of a signed amplitude silently; log only of |D| with sign tracked
detect and record every strict sign change of Delta_d, Z (and Delta_eff, tilt) with root refinement
report maximal intervals of validity of d ln D/d ln a; attach every f value to its interval
always retain the non-logarithmic derivative dD/dlna = -3Z/Theta (and dressed counterpart), finite through crossings
distinguish d ln|D|/d ln a from d ln D/d ln a
no interpolation/smoothing/plotting across a singularity without explicit annotation

zero_crossing_conclusion.source: artifacts/independent/phase1c_b2_convergence.json sampled sign-change bins; frozen validator trajectory_diagnostics definition; in-memory clean-system scan; bracket conversions via frozen bg.redshift
zero_crossing_conclusion.assumptions: upstream-convention baseline scenario (printed/derived branches, unrescaled_V, upstream rate/epoch/k)
zero_crossing_conclusion.derivation_summary: sampled B2 trajectories show Delta_d sign changes for printed 5pi/10pi and derived 2pi/5pi/10pi; Z changes sign in an earlier sampled bin for each; Delta_d crossings imply logarithmic-rate poles and Z crossings imply zeros; no root-refined locations are claimed; clean baselines show no sign crossing on the audited interval
zero_crossing_conclusion.convention_dependencies: brackets depend on D3 branch, epoch, rate units, and k convention; values have only the 1000-point grid provenance stated above
zero_crossing_conclusion.implementation_consequence: f must be reported piecewise; Phase 1D-B must root-refine sign changes with documented tolerances before publishing precise locations

sigma_R_definition.equation_chain: in one fixed spatial coordinate frame X, sigma_R^2(z) = <(delta_m * W_R)^2> = int d^3k_com_X/(2pi)^3 P_delta(k_com_X,z) W^2(k_com_X R_com_X) = (1/2pi^2) int dk_com_X k_com_X^2 P_delta W^2(k_com_X R_com_X) = int dlnk_com_X Delta^2_delta(k_com_X,z) W^2(k_com_X R_com_X); W(x) = 3(sin x - x cos x)/x^3; Delta^2_delta := k_com_X^3 P_delta/(2pi^2)
sigma_R_definition.sigma8: observational sigma_8 := sigma_R at observational/dressed comoving R_com_obs = R_8 = 8 h^-1 Mpc, paired with reciprocal observational/dressed comoving k_com_obs
sigma_R_definition.frame_pairing_rule: k_com_D may be paired only with a volume-average comoving radius R_com_D; observational R_8 requires k_com_obs and R_com_obs; the map from the volume-average harmonic coordinate to the dressed observational comoving coordinate is not derived; k_phys0_D cannot be inserted directly into k_com_obs R_com_obs merely because it is dimensional

reasons: sigma_R is an integral over a continuous lnk measure; three isolated modes supply neither the measure nor a justified quadrature/interpolation rule
equal deterministic trajectory amplitudes do not define an ensemble, P_Delta, P_delta, spectrum shape, or amplitude
the positions of the volume-average modes in an observational k_com_obs R_com_obs kernel are unknown because the volume-average-to-dressed comoving coordinate map is unresolved
a continuous statistical spectrum in one declared comoving coordinate frame, explicit amplitude/shape and reciprocal units, and a convergence-demonstrated integration domain are required
three_modes_cannot_give_sigma8.withdrawn_illustrations: the previous Planck-like kernel-peak range, comparison to it, and prescribed [1e-2,1e1] h/Mpc domain were removed because they were not sourced or established by a documented convergence calculation

sigma_R_conclusion.source: standard convolution derivation with the Fourier convention stated in power_spectrum_mapping
sigma_R_conclusion.assumptions: linear P_delta; top-hat window; stated Fourier convention; comoving wavenumber and radius defined in the same spatial coordinate system with reciprocal units
sigma_R_conclusion.derivation_summary: full sigma_R chain with all numerical factors; three-mode inadequacy follows from missing continuous statistical spectrum and explicit matched-frame comoving-unit conventions, without relying on an illustrative kernel-peak estimate
sigma_R_conclusion.convention_dependencies: h choice (timescape_dressed_h vs lcdm_reference_h), matched comoving spatial frame of k and R, F7 wavenumber convention, unresolved volume-average-to-dressed comoving map
sigma_R_conclusion.implementation_consequence: no observational sigma_R/sigma_8 code path may exist in 1D-B without an external spectrum input, explicit unit choices, and a derived k_com_D-to-k_com_obs spatial mapping

radius_and_h_conventions.spatial_unit_frame_of_R: must additionally be declared dressed / bare-volume-average / wall / reference-LCDM comoving; k_com_X and R_com_X must use the same frame and reciprocal units; the dressed observational mapping is not derived in [GM] and is an explicit blocker, not a default
radius_and_h_conventions.scale_factor_and_wavenumber_normalisatio: original notation retains a_w0 explicitly: 1+z=a_w0/a_w and a_obs=a_w/a_w0; frozen Phase 1B a_w and a_D are rescaled by a_w0, so a_w_rescaled(t0)=1 and a_D_rescaled(t0)=gamma_w0~1.3685; k_com_D=k_code H0_TS/c, k_phys_D(t)=k_com_D/a_D(t), k_phys0_D=k_code H0_TS/(a_D0 c), and lambda_phys0_D=2pi a_D0 c/(H0_TS k_code); paper input instead uses k_paper=k_phys0_D c/H0_LCDM before F7 conversion, which preserves k_phys0_D but does not derive k_com_obs

h_convention_conclusion.source: [GM] Fig. 3 caption (lcdm H0/c units) vs [GM] p.25 (H0 dressed 'directly extracted by observations'); Phase 1C-A F7
h_convention_conclusion.assumptions: none - this is a pure convention fork
h_convention_conclusion.derivation_summary: both h choices are self-consistent and move R_8 by 8.6%; a dimensionless window argument is h-invariant only when k_com_X and R_com_X are expressed in reciprocal h units within the same spatial coordinate frame
h_convention_conclusion.convention_dependencies: interacts with wavenumber_convention and with the matched comoving spatial frame of k and R
h_convention_conclusion.implementation_consequence: sigma_radius_h_convention in {timescape_dressed_h, lcdm_reference_h} must be a mandatory explicit argument; no default

upstream_amplitude_defines.conditional_inference: only if equal deterministic amplitudes were additionally interpreted as equal RMS amplitudes under one common statistical mode normalisation would D2 imply P_delta proportional to k_code^-4; the notebook does not define that ensemble

spectrum_requirements.validity_for_spectrum_normalisation: NOT scientifically valid: fixes one number at an unspecified effective scale; sigma_8 requires amplitude AND shape over the kernel support

external_linear_pk_at_zref.qualification: implementable only with an external transfer/linear P(k); imports LCDM-calibrated shape and amplitude at z_ref

sigma8_anchor_at_zref.qualification: normalisation-only, not predictive; shape-free for scale-independent growth, but scale-dependent growth additionally requires a spectrum shape

primordial_As_ns_external_transfer.qualification: requires an external transfer function and assumes its early-universe applicability

upstream_equal_deterministic_Delta_ampli.qualification: valid only for relative selected-mode comparisons; silent use is FORBIDDEN_AS_A_SILENT_DEFAULT

ic_amplitude_conclusion.source: [GM] Fig. 3 caption ('same values for all scales for direct comparison') + p.27 'compensating' sentence; Phase 1C-A qplus provenance (bit-exact)
ic_amplitude_conclusion.assumptions: the confirmed upstream statement is deterministic comparison normalisation; a k^-4 density-power inference would require the additional equal-RMS/common-statistical-mode-normalisation assumptions not made upstream
ic_amplitude_conclusion.derivation_summary: Delta_d(t_i)=0.0031427229788258105 is an equal deterministic selected-mode comparison amplitude; it defines no ensemble P_Delta or P_delta and cannot normalise a continuous spectrum or sigma_8
ic_amplitude_conclusion.convention_dependencies: F3 rate units, F4 epoch afflict the companion Z IC
ic_amplitude_conclusion.implementation_consequence: normalization_strategy=upstream_equal_deterministic_Delta_amplitude must be rejected at the API level for any sigma_8 code path; no default strategy anywhere

A3 fixed spectrum shape at z_ref
A4 fixed smoothing convention with k_com_X and R_com_X in the same spatial frame and reciprocal units

identity_conclusion.source: derivation chains D5-D6 (report Secs. 10, 12); sympy S5 PASS
identity_conclusion.derivation_summary: sigma_8(z)=D sigma_8(z_ref) and f sigma_8 = d sigma_8/dlna follow directly from the sigma_R integral when D is k-independent, positive and differentiable; the bare/dressed coordinate choice rescales f sigma_8 by 1.025-1.084

scale_dependent_generalization.equations: in one fixed spatial frame X, sigma_R^2(z) = int dlnk_com_X Delta^2_delta(k_com_X,z_ref) D^2(k_com_X,z) W^2(k_com_X R_com_X); F_R(z) := d sigma_R/d ln a = (1/sigma_R) int dlnk_com_X Delta^2_delta(k_com_X,z) f(k_com_X,z) W^2(k_com_X R_com_X); f_R_eff := F_R/sigma_R = kernel-weighted mean of the spectral growth rate with weights Delta^2_delta(k_com_X,z) W^2(k_com_X R_com_X)/sigma_R^2
scale_dependent_generalization.finiteness: the F_R integrand Delta^2(k,z_ref) D dD/dlna W^2 stays finite through individual mode zero crossings (D*D' finite even where ln D is singular); only sigma_R = 0 would be singular; differentiation under the integral requires dominated convergence (explicit assumption given rapidly growing high-k barotropic modes)
scale_dependent_generalization.naming_rule: d_sigma8_d_lna must NOT be automatically labelled f-sigma-8 in a scale-dependent model

generalization_conclusion.source: derivation chains D7-D8 (report Sec. 13); sympy S6 PASS (discrete-sum formal check)
generalization_conclusion.assumptions: linearity; external spectrum shape at z_ref; k_com_X and R_com_X in the same spatial frame and reciprocal units; dominated convergence for differentiation under the integral
generalization_conclusion.derivation_summary: f_R_eff is the Delta^2 W^2-weighted mean of f(k,z), distinct from the standard scale-independent f(z), coinciding with it only under A2
generalization_conclusion.convention_dependencies: all sigma_R conventions plus growth_coordinate; weights depend on the evolved spectrum, hence on the normalisation strategy
generalization_conclusion.implementation_consequence: any barotropic sigma-level growth quantity must use these weighted definitions and cautious labels

identifications.Delta_d: related to delta_m by -k_code^2, equivalently -(k_com_D c/H0_TS)^2 or -(k_phys0_D a_D0 c/H0_TS)^2 in the matching volume-average parametrisation, and to delta_g only through an additional bias model; not directly identifiable
identifications.Z: Z_k=-k_code^2(deltaTheta)_k, with deltaTheta the dust-congruence expansion fluctuation; exact CGI continuity deltadot_m=-(deltaTheta) follows; correspondence to the FLRW RSD velocity divergence is PROVISIONAL and direct observable identification is NOT_JUSTIFIED_FOR_OBSERVABLE_USE without a dressed mapping, velocity-bias analysis, continuity interpretation, and explicit H normalisation
identifications.V_eff_Vtilde_eff: effective-fluid tilt relative to dust; no automatic galaxy-velocity interpretation
identifications.d_sigma8_d_lna: density-derived; equals RSD-inferred fsigma8 only under Secs. 12-13 assumptions + (a)-(d) + a normalisation

rsd_conclusion.source: [GM] definitions (2.4), (2.20), (4.14); [GM] conclusions (fsigma8 only as 'a natural extension of this work'); Percival-White full text Secs. 2.1-2.3 Eqs. (1)-(14); derivation chain D9
rsd_conclusion.derivation_summary: no state variable is directly the observed RSD velocity-growth combination; Percival-White verifies the conditional standard FLRW chain but not its Timescape applicability; missing links include normalisation, a continuous statistical spectrum in the observational comoving frame, the volume-average-to-dressed comoving map, dressed redshift-space mapping, bias/velocity interpretation, fiducial/AP conversion, and unresolved conventions; [GM] makes no fsigma8 prediction

rsd_conclusion.implementation_consequence: no RSD dataset, likelihood, covariance, fiducial correction, or fit may be implemented; the classification is about current evidence, not the framework's potential
